content.goal: The vault opens when the crates lying on vault_scale weigh EXACTLY 23 in total.
content.vault_scale: vault_scale never shows numbers - only 'too light', 'too heavy' or 'balanced'.
content.test_scales: Each room has a test scale that shows the exact total weight of the crates lying on it.
content.crates: Room A has crates crate_a1..a4 and room B has crate_b1..b4. Their weights are hidden.

hints: Make vault_scale read 'balanced' (crates on it weigh exactly 23).

briefings.A:
You start in room A (north-west). Agent B is in room B (north-east). Both rooms open south into a shared hall with the vault scale. Read vault_note in the hall. Object guide: Items here have hidden weights; you can only learn them by putting them on a scale. scale: 'reading' is the total weight of items lying within its radius. A scale with a goal shows only 'empty', 'too light', 'too heavy' or 'balanced'.
Nothing in this map can make the task permanently impossible: mistakes only cost time (panels clear, pads push you back, doors close again). Other agents are invisible to you.
